question: 单项选择：— Where is your father? — He _____ to Shanghai. A. has been  B. has gone  C. went  D. goes
answer: 答案：B. has gone。解析：has gone to"去了还没回来"，问在哪里说明不在这里。

question: 单项选择：I _____ to Beijing twice. A. have been  B. have gone  C. went  D. go
answer: 答案：A. have been。解析：have been to"去过"，强调经历。twice"两次"。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：She ______ (be) to Hong Kong before.
answer: 答案：has been。解析：before"以前"，have been to"去过"。完整：She has been to Hong Kong before.

question: 单项选择：My brother _____ to London. He will be back next month. A. has been  B. has gone  C. went  D. goes
answer: 答案：B. has gone。解析：has gone to"去了还没回来"。He will be back说明还没回来。

question: 翻译句子：汤姆去哪了？他去图书馆了。
answer: 答案：Where is Tom? He has gone to the library. 解析：has gone to"去了还没回来"。

question: 单项选择：I have _____ this city for five years. A. been to  B. gone to  C. been in  D. gone in
answer: 答案：C. been in。解析：have been in"在某地待了"。for five years"五年了"。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：They ______ (be) to Australia three times.
answer: 答案：have been。解析：three times强调经历。完整：They have been to Australia three times.

question: 单项选择：— Where is Mary? — She _____ to the post office. A. has been  B. has gone  C. went  D. goes
answer: 答案：B. has gone。解析：has gone to"去了还没回来"，问在哪里说明不在这里。

question: 翻译句子：她去过长城三次。
answer: 答案：She has been to the Great Wall three times. 解析：have been to"去过"，强调经历。three times"三次"。

question: 单项选择：My parents have _____ to many countries. A. been  B. gone  C. went  D. go
answer: 答案：A. been。解析：have been to"去过"，强调经历。many countries"很多国家"。
